applicabilityBasis.summary: skyMoneyUsdtSavings is an ERC-4626 receipt share in a USDT-denominated Morpho Vault V2 lending strategy curated through Sky.money. The exact product accepts USDT and supplies an sUSDS-collateralized lending market. Interest and realized losses change assets per share, and withdrawals depend on available liquidity. The share is marketed as a yield strategy and carries no fixed monetary-value redemption promise of the kind described in GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: Assessment applies to the vault share at Ethereum address 0x23f5e9c35820f4bab695ac1f19c203cc3f8e1e11 separately from underlying USDT. Skybase International is identified by its governing terms as the interface operator and vault curator; this role does not establish a separate payment-stablecoin issuer or fixed-fiat redemption obligor for the share. issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are therefore omitted. Returns and losses affect the share exchange rate, and redemption returns the underlying cryptoasset through smart-contract accounting and available liquidity. No GENIUS authorization, foreign registration or issuer pathway is asserted. Underlying-token authorizations and reserve reports are not inherited by the vault share. Reserve, redemption-policy and monthly-attestation flags are omitted rather than inferred from underlying-token disclosures. This payment-stablecoin scope assessment does not determine treatment under securities or other financial-services law.
